request_scope: supplier must identify actual exact module, not a substitute product category
DFRobot_DFR1262_specific_requests: Provide ordered bare-module OEM SKU, lot/revision identification, and mapping to DFX-TM667009 Rev A versus supplied flexible no-touch kit.
Confirm whether FT3658U on-cell/touch7pin and CG assembly in the linked PDF actually apply to the shipped kit, and provide the correctly scoped complete drawing including seal/COF/FPC/adapter tail.
Provide direct-MIPI initialization and PMIC schematics/BOM and explain pin-name voltage suffixes versus DDIC DC values; specify actual full-load/inrush/brownout currents, modes and lane rate.

Confirm material axis and bend side, all no-bend regions, laminate/neutral plane, approved dynamic radius/twist/tension/support/friction for the exact 79.75mm+8.2mm route. The 2.51mm CG-BPL clearance is not assumed to be a radius.
Provide exact module/lot dynamic optical/touch/seal qualification and explain sales-page no-humidity-test scope versus generic PDF environmental conditions.
DisplayModule_DMKDO06501DNA_specific_req: Provide signed consistent SKU-to-OEM drawing 97065003A revision mapping and corrected complete pinout: duplicatedpin5/pin7AVDD, pin8AVDD_EN versusREST, pin12ID2 versusGND, pin10logicrail name and ELVDD side-contact polarity.
Correct electrical rating min/max for negative ELVSS, touch current/voltage labels, and identify actually supplied touch IC/laminate/driver and connector wiring.

Reconcile 6.48inch label with154.560x69.552mm AA, verticalpitch0.060mm, 2240-line input timing versus2400array, H Total/porches, exact command/video mode, rate/DSC and approved full initialization matching ordered revision.

Provide original terminal orientation and mating drawing for exact BK13C06-40DP/DS suffix865; confirm orderable part/revision, side power contacts and key/mating orientation without aliasing to800/895 or BM28.

Provide full3D/tolerances including FPC112.386mm tail and local1.01/.95mm component heights, seal/DDIC/no-bend regions, protectivefilm removal state, touch/cover/adhesive and approved neutral-plane materials.

Approve or reject the exact rolling route, bend axes/radius/tension/twist/pressure/flat-storage dwell and provide relevant dynamic tests for the supplied module; environmental reference tables/Visionox reference reports alone do not qualify this phone.
